page.title: Planning
page.workPeriodsSubtitle: Plan shift assignments, inform collaborators, and record actual outcomes.
page.emptyDescription: Create the first shift-like work period to begin planning.
page.validationComplete: Complete the work date, period code, name, start time, and end time.

detail.outcomesIntro: Record what actually happened for each included collaborator.

plan.title: Plan Assignments
plan.description: Select collaborators for this Work Period. New plans start from the most recent Work Period with the same period code. Saving applies the selected rows only; unselected rows are ignored unless their Availability was changed for inheritance by the next plan.
plan.instructions: Use Plan Assignment to refine a collaborator's sector, local, and task before saving the Work Period plan. Use Cand. and Repl. to mark temporary replacements for this Work Period only. Future defaults are updated only when explicitly selected in that refinement workflow.
plan.noTemplate: No prior same-type Work Period template was found, or this Work Period already has saved assignments.
plan.empty: No active collaborators are available for planning.
plan.refinementApplied: Assignment refinement applied to this Work Period plan. Click Plan to save it.
plan.refinementAppliedWithDefaults: Assignment refinement applied and future planning defaults updated. Click Plan to save this Work Period assignment.
plan.filtersDescription: Filters only change which rows are visible. Temporary replacement choices are saved only for this Work Period; they do not update future planning defaults.
plan.emptyFilters: No collaborators match the current planning filters.
plan.refinementDescription: Refine sector, local, and task for this Work Period plan. Future Collaborator defaults change only when explicitly selected below.
plan.futureDefaultsLabel: Use these values as future planning defaults for this Collaborator
plan.futureDefaultsDescription: This is the only option in this workflow that updates the Collaborator Journey defaults. The Work Period assignment is still saved by clicking Plan selected collaborators.

inform.title: Inform Collaborators
inform.description: Review the included roster, then print and post it at the Canteen.
inform.warningDescription: Before informing or printing, review these Day Off / Leave of Absence collaborators that do not have a replacement in this Work Period:

accrual.title: Accrual
accrual.description: Review recorded well production, calculate collaborator earnings, review pending items, and post ready credits.
accrual.goldProducedDescription: Gold Produced is read-only in Accrual. Authorized actors must use the Gold Production workflow to create or edit mine production.
accrual.emptyGoldProduction: No gold production has been recorded for this Work Period. Commission accrual items that require production will remain pending until an authorized actor records it in Gold Production.
accrual.accrualRunsDescription: Calculation is repeatable; posting only affects READY items.
accrual.postedMessage: Posted items are now visible in Current Accounts.
accrual.postedMessageDetails: Use the row links below to verify each posted earning credit or transfer in the collaborator ledger.
accrual.emptyItems: No accrual items for this run.
